pages.text: $(o)A great white beast asleep among the snowfields and ice spikes.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its breath freezes everything in front of it, and it slams anyone who crowds it. Fight from its flanks and roll the slam.$(br2)It sleeps until disturbed. Wake it only when the whole party is ready.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Rimefang Tusk$() counts for the quest book.
